title: VisualEvolve: A Skill Self-Evolution Framework for Visual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28386v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual tool use enables vision-language models (VLMs) to acquire task-relevant evidence, but its effectiveness can be limited by predefined visual operations and the tool-use strategies learned during training. Representing these operations and strategies as reusable external skills allows them to be refined through self-evolution without updating model parameters. However, skill refinement can introduce performance regressions. Meanwhile, inspecting accumulated task execution trajectories together with skill evolution history may lead to evolution evidence overload. To address these challenges, we propose VisualEvolve, a self-evolving framework that evolves executable visual operations and tool-use strategies for VLMs through a Select--Execute--Evolve--Evaluate cycle. translated_title: VisualEvolve：一种面向视觉推理的技能自进化框架
translated_abstract: 视觉工具使用使视觉语言模型（VLM）能够获取与任务相关的证据，但其有效性可能受限于预定义的视觉操作以及训练期间学习到的工具使用策略。将这些操作和策略表示为可复用的外部技能，使其能够通过自进化进行改进，而无需更新模型参数。然而，技能改进可能引入性能回退；同时，检视累积的任务执行轨迹连同技能进化历史可能导致进化证据过载。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了VisualEvolve，一个通过“选择—执行—进化—评估”循环为VLM进化可执行视觉操作和工具使用策略的自进化框架。技能库快照选择（Skill-Library Snapshot Selection）利用与执行任务不相交的固定验证集上的性能，为后续进化选择有效的历史快照……
tldr: VisualEvolve提出了一个无需更新模型参数的自进化框架，通过“选择—执行—进化—评估”循环和技能库快照选择机制，持续改进视觉语言模型的视觉操作与工具使用技能，同时避免性能回退和进化证据过载。
en_tdlr: VisualEvolve is a self-evolution framework that refines VLMs' visual operations and tool-use strategies without parameter updates, using a Select-Execute-Evolve-Evaluate cycle and skill-library snapshot selection to prevent performance regressions and evolution evidence overload.
